mentions.name: USM tools
mentions.description: A set of tools for better service management based on the Unified Service Management (USM) model, enabling services to be defined as structured data instead of documentation.
mentions.problem: Services are typically defined through documentation rather than as data.
mentions.source_excerpt: Continuing USM tools, set of tools for better service management based on Unified Service Management (USM) model. The basic idea is better to define your services as data, instead of documentation.

evidence.value: Continuing USM tools, set of tools for better service management based on Unified Service Management (USM) model. The basic idea is better to define your services as data, instead of documentation.
